data.reasoningText:
Now I understand the patterns. Let me look at a few more files to understand how the serialization calls work and then implement the changes.

The key observation is that many types have `[JsonConverter(typeof(XxxConverter))]` attributes and custom `JsonConverter<T>` classes. These converters handle the serialization.
